newsitem.title: USA: U.S. court rejects blocking Conrail - CSX merger.
newsitem.headline: U.S. court rejects blocking Conrail - CSX merger.

text.p: U.S . district judge Donald Van Artsdalen rejected all motions by Norfolk Southern Corp and Conrail Inc shareholders to block an intended merger between Conrail and CSX Corp.
Van Artsdalen said in announcing his decision that the actions by Conrail's board of directors were protected by Pennsylvania law and the board did not violate its fiduciary duties.
Norfolk Southern attorney Steven Rothschild immediately said Norfolk Southern had started the process of appealing the decision.

Parties involved in the case had said previously that the U.S. Third Circuit Court of Appeals would hear the case Wednesday, prior to the midnight expiration of CSX's tender offer for 19.9 percent of Conrail shares.
